title: Relief Installment Calculation Sheet
content:
Calculation sheet — **Patient Payment Plans**: the relief installment of a plan whose term recomputes the installment after a financial-assistance release.

## Formal statement

The relief installment is the plan's carried balance divided by the installments still to fall due, rounded to the nearest cent with an exact half cent rounded up, and it is never below the plan term's minimum installment; when the quotient is lower, the relief installment is that minimum.

The carried balance is the invoice balances enrolled on the plan, less the down payment fixed when the plan was accepted, less every scheduled-installment, arrears, extra-principal and payoff payment on the plan ledger, less every release on the plan ledger.

The installments still to fall due are the term's installments less those whose due date has already passed, the passed ones counted as the whole months from the plan's first due date to today plus one.

The installments the carried balance is divided by never carry the plan past its 24th installment: they are never more than 24 less the installments whose due date has already passed.

## Inputs and where they are read

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Invoice balances enrolled | Every enrollment line on the plan ledger, added together |
| Down payment fixed at acceptance | The down-payment figure on the plan record |
| Payments subtracted | Every ledger payment posted as a scheduled installment, an arrears payment, an extra-principal payment or a payoff |
| Releases | Every release line on the plan ledger, whatever its reason |
| Term's installments | The number of monthly installments of the plan's term |
| First due date | The due date of installment 1, on the plan record |
| Minimum installment | The term's smallest regular installment |

Down payments enter the carried balance only as the figure fixed at acceptance.

## Worked sheet (hypothetical 12-month plan)

Enrollment lines 1,800.00. Down payment fixed at acceptance 180.00. Five scheduled installments of 135.00 paid (675.00). No arrears, extra-principal or payoff payments. One financial-assistance release of 360.00. First due date 15 January; today 20 June.

1. Carried balance: 1,800.00 less 180.00 less 675.00 less 360.00 is **585.00**.
2. Installments passed: 5 whole months from 15 January to 20 June, plus one, is 6.
3. Installments still to fall due: 12 less 6 is **6** (within the 24th-installment limit, which here allows up to 18).
4. Quotient: 585.00 divided by 6 is 97.50.
5. The term's minimum installment is 40.00; 97.50 is not below it.
6. Relief installment: **97.50**.

**Rounding.** Had the carried balance been 590.00, the quotient would be 98.333…, giving 98.33.

**Minimum.** Had the carried balance been 150.00, the quotient would be 25.00, below 40.00, and the relief installment would be 40.00.
